title: Coordinate-invariant induced-theta norm reconciliation

predecessor.issue: The full Z8+G1..G8 transform is exactly invertible to Z16 yet retained 2187 collisions under componentwise coordinate L_inf, proving that metric is not invariant under an invertible coordinate transform.

purpose: Re-evaluate the exact same frozen 256 candidate family using the quotient norm induced by the original 16-cell theta L_inf norm, without changing the theta floor, candidate components, discovery population, or deterministic subset-selection rule.

unchanged_authority.discovery_population: D01-D08 exact ROM1B3 frozen discovery states
unchanged_authority.candidate_family: Z8 plus any subset of the same G1..G8 half-contrasts

induced_norm.definition: q_S(delta_z) = min ||delta_theta||_inf over all 16-cell delta_theta satisfying the selected Z8 mean and G-contrast coordinate differences
induced_norm.global: maximum of the eight bandwise closed-form values
properties: Z8-only induced norm equals the original Z8 component L_inf norm
with all G1..G8 selected the induced norm equals the exact cellwise Z16 theta L_inf norm
monotone nondecreasing when G components are added

deterministic_selection.primary: minimum number of added G components among zero-collision candidates
deterministic_selection.secondary: maximum minimum induced_candidate_theta_Linf over all cross-history pairs with full_theta_Linf > theta_floor

next_rule.if_selected_added_count_lt_8: freeze the selected candidate and preregister held-out state-separation plus predictive evaluation before exposing H01-H04
next_rule.if_selected_added_count_eq_8: close the physically interpretable water-content-only reduction family as requiring full theta state; a qualitatively new state class requires a separate scientific proposition
